slides.body: Mercury (Budha) is the planet of analysis, numbers and communication. Its strength is sharp thinking.
Too much Mercury energy can mean endless research, constant tinkering and many small tactical moves. Activity feels like progress.
Overtrading and analysis-paralysis are known biases. Frequent action raises costs and stress, often without better results.

points: Limit how often you change the plan
Write one line on why before every move
Consult a licensed advisor for real decisions

slides.body: Think of the 2nd house as what you keep and the 11th as what you gain. Steady habits serve both better than constant motion.
No yoga guarantees wealth, and no planet predicts a market. This is behavioral awareness, not financial advice or a stock pick.
Free Mercury Placement Check: see how you think about money.
